headline: BARRICK FILES NYSE IPO FOR NORTH AMERICAN GOLD — "AMERICAN BARRICK GOLD" SEEKS UP TO $6B; CARLIN, CORTEZ, PUEBLO VIEJO IN SPIN-OFF
snippet: Barrick Mining has filed a Form S-11 registration statement with the SEC to take its North American gold operations public as a separate NYSE-listed entity under the ticker ABGC — holding 61.5% of Nevada Gold Mines (Carlin, Cortez, Turquoise Ridge) and 60% of Pueblo Viejo in the Dominican Republic, with the IPO seeking up to US$6 billion and valuation estimates ranging as high as $42 billion. The offering has not yet priced; Barrick plans to retain majority control and return net proceeds to its existing shareholders.

headline: COT NOV 13: GOLD SPECULATORS AT 3-YEAR POSITIONING LOW — Silver Bears Near Washout Extreme, Contrarian Signal Flashing
snippet: Friday's Commitments of Traders report shows large speculative net long positions in gold futures at their lowest level in roughly three years, with silver shorts near a historic extreme — a classic contrarian signal that in prior gold corrections has preceded sharp recoveries. The data arrives as spot gold trades near $3,883 and speculative money has been fleeing the sector for seven consecutive sessions, compressing futures positioning to levels that have historically marked or bracketed important bottoms.

headline: STORM EXPLORATION HITS VMS MINERALIZATION IN ALL 8 HOLES — 7KM SYSTEM AT GOLD STANDARD ONTARIO KEEPS EXPANDING
snippet: Storm Exploration (TSXV: STRM) reported November 12 that all eight holes in its latest program at the Gold Standard Project in northwestern Ontario intersected disseminated and/or semi-massive to massive sulphide mineralisation — confirming system continuity along a 7 km geophysical conductor identified as a bimodal-mafic VMS type by Dr. Stephen Piercey. Assay results are expected in early Q1 2027; the company has a CA$3.2M financing in place to continue drilling.

headline: AZTEC MINERALS DRILLS 70.1m @ 0.80g/t AuEq FROM SURFACE — Tombstone Arizona Gold-Silver Porphyry Footprint Grows
snippet: Aztec Minerals (TSXV: AZT) reported that hole TR26-54 at its Tombstone gold-silver porphyry project in Arizona returned 70.1 metres of 0.80 g/t gold-equivalent (0.49 g/t Au and 16.85 g/t Ag) starting from surface — a broad, shallow intercept in an area the company has been systematically expanding with step-out drilling. The near-surface geometry is a key economic consideration for any future open-pit scenario at Tombstone.

headline: ATALAYA CLOSES €125M THARSIS ACQUISITION — 227MT RESOURCE ADDED TO SPANISH COPPER COMPLEX, ZERO SHAREHOLDER DILUTION
snippet: Atalaya Mining (AIM/TSX: ATYM) completed its €125 million acquisition of private Spanish firm Tharsis Mining on November 11, paying €75 million upfront and deferring €50 million for 12 months — adding the past-producing Tharsis and La Zarza mines in southwest Spain, with combined mineral resources of approximately 227.7 Mt, to its existing Riotinto operations. No equity was issued; existing shareholders experience zero dilution.

headline: MMG REVISES EU CONCESSIONS FOR $500M ANGLO NICKEL BID — EC Warns Chinese Buyer Could Reroute European Ferronickel Supply
snippet: Chinese mining giant MMG is revising its proposed remedies for the European Commission's antitrust review of its US$500 million bid for Anglo American's Brazilian nickel operations, after the EC flagged concerns that a Chinese-controlled acquirer could redirect ferronickel volumes away from European customers. The case is an early template for how Western regulators are applying critical-mineral supply-chain logic to M&A approvals.

headline: WGC: Q3 MINE OUTPUT HITS RECORD 1,071t BUT TOTAL SUPPLY FALLS — Recycling Craters to 3-Year Low as Holders Sit Tight
snippet: The World Gold Council's Q3 2026 Gold Demand Trends report shows mine output rose 3% year-over-year to a record 1,071 tonnes — with full-year 2026 on track for an all-time high — but total gold supply still slipped to 1,369 tonnes as recycling fell to a three-year low of 314 tonnes, suggesting existing holders are not selling into the correction at current prices.

headline: USA RARE EARTH SINKS 11% ON Q3 MISS, BOUNCES 11% NEXT DAY — CHINA EXPORT PAUSE EXPIRY PUTS WESTERN PRODUCERS BACK IN SPOTLIGHT
snippet: USA Rare Earth (USAR) swung 11% lower on November 10 after Q3 results badly missed consensus (revenue ~$3M vs ~$13.5M expected) despite recording first commercial magnet sales from Serra Verde, then rebounded 11% the following session — with the volatility partly linked to the November 10 expiry of China's rare earth export-control pause, which refocuses strategic buyers on the limited Western producer alternatives for defence and EV magnet supply chains.

headline: GOLD MINERS Q3'26: VALUATIONS NEAR RECORD LOWS EVEN AT $4,000 GOLD — Zeal Maps the Disconnect Between Earnings and Price
snippet: Zeal Research's Q3 gold miner fundamentals review finds that rate-hike fears and macro risk-off sentiment have compressed gold equity valuations to near-record lows relative to the gold price — even with $4,000+ realized prices driving strong actual earnings across the sector. The analysis argues the discount reflects temporary sentiment extremes rather than fundamental deterioration, and maps the valuation gap across major and mid-tier producers.

headline: BARRICK Q3: AISC JUMPS 24% TO $1,911/oz — But 41% EPS Beat Proves $4,000 Gold Is Still Doing the Heavy Lifting
snippet: Barrick Mining reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS up 41% year-over-year as gold prices above $4,000 more than offset all-in sustaining costs surging to $1,911 per ounce — up 24% from $1,538 a year earlier — driven by lower grades, higher royalties, and diesel costs. The result illustrates the sector's core tension: absolute cash generation remains strong at current gold prices, but the AISC trajectory is tightening margins and will bite harder if gold continues its November correction.

headline: AIC MINES ACQUIRES MT CUTHBERT COPPER FOR A$120M — HAWKE'S POINT TAKES 9.27% AS STRATEGIC BACKER IN A$70M PLACEMENT
snippet: AIC Mines (ASX: A1M) is acquiring the Mt Cuthbert Copper Project in Queensland for A$120 million, funded in part by a A$70 million placement that brought in London-based private equity firm Hawke's Point as a 9.27% strategic shareholder — institutional backing that arrives even as LME copper sits near four-month lows, with physical tightness in China (SHFE stocks at a three-year low) providing the underlying demand rationale.

headline: DISCOVERY SILVER POSTS RECORD Q3 GOLD OUTPUT — $258M ADJUSTED EARNINGS YTD, NEARLY 3X YEAR-OVER-YEAR
snippet: Discovery Silver (TSX: DSV) reported record gold production and sales in Q3 2026, contributing to adjusted net earnings of $258.1 million year-to-date versus $86.5 million in the same period of 2025 — a nearly threefold increase — as operations ran at capacity with realized gold prices well above $4,000 per ounce. The result positions Discovery as one of the cleaner earnings stories in the junior-to-mid-tier gold space amid a sector-wide correction.
